Readable core vocabulary (resource_kind, size, engine names) is unchanged
Published results-data bytes and result_ids unchanged
context:
Found 2026-10-14 by a review probe while verifying the core execution-variants remediation on develop 9400b62c4. It became reachable when compute metadata started carrying resource, kind and size in every bundle (#2946).
Batch: _project/handoffs/execution-variant-general-followups-batch-20261014.md, started 2026-10-14
description:
## Problem
- The anonymizer drops `resource` only as a child of `compute` (`public_drop_child_keys`, `benchbox/core/results/anonymization_specs.yaml:27-29`; `anonymization.py:497-500`).
- Compute metadata also lands at `platform.raw_metadata.platform_compute.resource` (`environment.py:333-335`, `schema.py:500-504`, Redshift `redshift.py:473,563`). There it survives in clear text, while its sibling `workgroup` is hashed.
- A bare `resource` key anywhere else survives too.
- Affected: Redshift, Databricks, Snowflake, Firebolt and ClickHouse Cloud bundles exported with `anonymize=True`.
- Published data is not affected today: none of the 782 `results-data` JSON files on develop 9400b62c4 contains `platform_compute.resource`. The next public bundle from those platforms would leak the name.

## Change
- Drop or hash `resource` wherever compute metadata appears, at least under `platformcompute`, and add it to `identifier_keys`.
- Add an exporter-level test that uses real adapter `platform_metadata` (not a hand-built dict).
